memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild dizziness on sudden head movements, able to work as vegetable vendor, ADL independent.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), no impairment.
falls: denies falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 5 regular (betahistine 16 mg BD, meclizine 25 mg SOS, clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topically, calcipotriol ointment OD topically, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly); polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria needed.
mood: denies low mood or anxiety, reports good spirits.
carers: mother, Sushila, provides occasional help with market stall.
goals: "I want to stay steady on my feet and keep my skin clear for work."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg twice daily

clobetasol 0.05% cream apply twice daily to psoriatic plaques

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve noticed my psoriasis patches getting redder and itchier over the past two weeks, especially on my elbows and knees. I’ve been using the creams as prescribed but they don’t seem to help as much. Also, I felt a bit dizzy yesterday when I reached for a high shelf at the stall.
